faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about Docito

bookAppointment.question: How do I book an appointment?
bookAppointment.answer: Simply search for a doctor by specialty or location, view their available slots, and book instantly. You'll receive immediate confirmation via email and SMS.

secureData.question: Is my health data secure?
secureData.answer: Yes. Docito uses modern authentication, encryption in transit and at rest, and role-based access controls to protect your data.

useInsurance.question: Can I use my insurance?
useInsurance.answer: If your provider supports it, select your insurance during booking. Coverage details appear before the visit and claims can be handled inside the platform.

doctorsJoin.question: How do doctors join the platform?
doctorsJoin.answer: Providers create a profile, verify their organization, and begin accepting bookings as their team onboards.

mobileApp.question: Is there a mobile app?
mobileApp.answer: A Docito mobile app for iOS and Android is coming soon. Join the waitlist to be notified at launch.

cancelReschedule.question: What if I need to cancel or reschedule?
cancelReschedule.answer: You can cancel or reschedule from your appointment details. The team is notified and availability updates in real time.
